normalize.note: ImageNet stats. Applied per channel AFTER dividing pixels by 255: (v - mean) / std

resize.note: Model is fixed 512x512 (static ONNX axes). Resize the input crop to exactly 512x512 before inference. There is NO aspect-ratio letterboxing in training - training used a plain resize - so match that: plain resize, no padding.

output.name: logits
output.note: Raw logits, NOT softmaxed. Take argmax over the class axis (axis=1) per pixel to get the class-index mask. Apply softmax only if you need per-class probabilities/confidence.

student_fp16.onnx.recommended_for: SHIP THIS. Best size/quality tradeoff for the web. Runs on WebGPU and WASM (wasm executes fp16 weights via fp32 upcast).

student_int8.onnx.recommended_for: smallest download, but visibly lossier on thin lines - only use if 5.9MB matters more than quality. Verify visually before shipping.
